index.heading: Card Brand Routing — How It Works
index.summary: Title block and scope note for the Merchant Routing Service brand-routing KB page. States explicitly that this is steady-state engineering reference material, not a change or a mandate.

index.heading: Supported card brands
index.summary: Brands the service routes: Mastercard, Visa, Discover. Names the current brand-identification mechanism — the card brand is resolved from the PAN bin range during authorization.

index.heading: Routing
index.summary: Dispatch after brand resolution: the router hands the message to a brand-specific handler (mc_handler, visa_handler, discover_handler). Notes that routing is table-driven and reloadable without a deploy.

index.heading: Transaction flow
index.summary: The five-step authorization pipeline in order: authorization, brand resolution, handler dispatch, response normalization, ledger write. Each step emits a tracing span.

index.heading: Error handling
index.summary: Handler-unavailable behaviour: the router applies a configured fallback and records error code EBRAND_UNAVAILABLE; retries are bounded.
